title: Chapter 425
paragraphs: Chapter 425
123. All of a sudden? (3)
"Kyaaah!"
"Eugh!"

Nobles and merchants who hadn't learned martial arts instinctively screamed. They mistakenly thought that Rata had attacked Jin, and it was difficult for them to understand the situation immediately even after seeing Rata's severed right index finger.
"What are you doing, Rata Prochi!"
"This is the Sword Garden!"
The eyes of the guardians with swords pointed at Rata's neck were twitching. Ten swords were choking his neck, but the guardians felt it.
If Rata wanted to, he could easily deflect all the swords they had pointed at him and move as he wished.
'The Phantom Commander is more dangerous than the rumors. He overwhelms us even after cutting off his own index finger with his bare hands.'
'Good thing he cut off his own finger, otherwise, if he had attacked the 12th Knight…'
The guardians shook their heads inwardly as they thought that far.
'It probably wouldn't have been a big deal. The 12th Knight is no ordinary monster either.'
Sticky blood flowed from the cut surface of Rata's index finger, and Jin looked at it without flinching.
What are you doing?
Jin didn't ask such a question. He just waited with an expressionless face. He wanted Rata to explain the reason for his actions first.
That's why, on the other hand, Rata seemed more bizarrely powerful, even though he suddenly pulled out a weapon and acted impulsively.
To begin with, there was a different weight to Jin. Apart from his martial prowess, Jin had an indescribable dignity...
Rata felt that way. It was so strange that he realized this fact so late that Jin had something different from other saints he had met so far.
"I know, but let me introduce myself formally again. I am the owner of Gwigok Castle and the leader of the Phantom Mercenary Group, Rata Prochi."
Everyone present couldn't help but be surprised again by his polite tone.

Of course, they had all heard rumors about the Phantom Commander more than once or twice. The king of ruthless killers without blood or tears, that was the image of the Phantom Commander that ordinary people thought of.
"I am Jin Runckand, the 12th Knight of Runckand."
"The reason I came to apologize today is to apologize for my rudeness at the Sword Emperor Castle last time."
Jin, looking down at the fallen index finger.
"So you cut off your index finger to apologize?"
"That's right."

Losing an index finger didn't cause significant damage to Rata's martial prowess. If it was an ordinary warrior, it might have been different, but for those who had already reached such a level, this kind of handicap was not a problem.
However, the reason Rata cut off his index finger was to pay the price in blood.
"Put away your swords."
At Jin's command, the guardians withdrew their swords from Rata's neck.
"Knight Lata."
"Speak."
"Between the knight and me, there is no grudge. Therefore, you do not need to apologize to me, and your finger holds no value for me."
Lata's eyes trembled.
However, it was not trembling due to humiliation or insult. The emotion in his eyes seemed closer to anxiety.
"…Even if I cut off a few more?"
No, why do you keep trying to cut off your fingers?
Instead of asking that, he chose a different answer.
"Even if you cut off your arm, it would be the same."
"Damn, I should have prepared something else. How can I make up for my mistake? Tell me. I'll do my best to meet your demands."

At those words, the people in the hall couldn't help but exchange glances. Was that really the Ghost Corps Commander? Everyone had that kind of reaction, and even the guardian knights couldn't hide their shock.
Even Jin couldn't help but be inwardly flustered.
'Lata Prochi, that's not his character. Why is he so humble?'
The reason Jin was somewhat cold to Lata was nothing else.
People like Lata, in other words, animal-like characters, need to be seen as scary and difficult when dealing with them.
Animals value hierarchy very much, so he thought it was necessary to make it clear that he was obviously in a higher position than Lata.
Therefore, Jin was anticipating that in the process, he would have another duel with Lata.
The duel held in the Sword Emperor City was actually Jin's victory, but since the outcome was inconclusive due to the terror, it didn't count.
'When Lata goes berserk because of my attitude, I was going to use that as an excuse to fight.'
Defeating the Ghost Corps Commander in front of the whole family would undoubtedly be a good thing.
Afterward, acknowledging each other with a warm atmosphere, and naturally letting everyone know that he was receiving considerable favor from the Ghost Corps.
That was the picture Jin wanted from this meeting.
'I don't need to fight like this.'
Without having to fight again and kneel, Lata was clearly showing a submissive posture to anyone who saw it.

'After the terror incident at the Sword Emperor City, Lata kept lurking around me during his stay. I thought he was going to demand to settle the score with different conditions, but was he actually looking for an opportunity to apologize?'
Drip, drip. Thick drops of blood continued to stain the floor from Lata's severed finger.
"Knight Lata, honestly, I thought you would challenge me to another fight."
"I'm not that much of a fool. I realized then that I'm not yet ready to fight against a Twelve Swordsman."
Eventually, people started murmuring at his words.
'What did he say?'
'There were rumors that the two fought during the Sword Emperor City terror incident, and the Twelve Swordsman was in a superior position.'
"Even so, can the difference between the Ghost Corps Commander and me be that significant?"

During the duel, many warriors had considered Lata to be superior to Jin. So, between the 'Twelve Swordsman of Runecandle' and the 'Ghost Corps Commander,' the latter originally held a weightier position.
"Then, Knight Lata, you don't have to apologize to me, but rather, repay your debt. Do you remember?"
-Should we bet on the duel?
-Don't you have someone to find from me?
-I'll get a blood oath before I kill you.

-Blood oath or whatever. If you win, I will grant whatever you want. You can take my life or do any humiliating act while I'm still breathing. However, if I win, the Ghost Corps must perform one request for me.
Jin recalled the conversation during the duel.
"Of course, I remember."

"To fulfill my request, Knight Lata must become even stronger than you are now. You shouldn't be cutting off your fingers. However, I doubt if you are truly capable of taking on my request. Guardian Knight, quickly escort the Medical Director to my room."
"Yes!"
With a snap, Jin unfolded the Ice Sealing Magic and picked up Lata's severed finger.
"Follow me."

As they left the reception room and headed for the room, a sudden intense vibration occurred within the Sword Garden. It wasn't a natural phenomenon like an earthquake, but rather a phenomenon that occurred when someone used tremendous power.
Moreover, the sky was dyed in pitch-black darkness.
Lata had experienced this phenomenon once before when Murakan had revealed his power at Sword Emperor City.
"This is your Guardian Dragon…"
"Ah, it seems to have started. You don't need to worry about it."
Lata was curious about what had started but did not ask further. Jin didn't seem to want him to ask.
On the way to the room, Jin wondered what kind of mindset Lata had to act like this.
'I hope it's not thoughtless to show such a demeanor.'
The Medical Director, called by the Guardian Knight, arrived first and was waiting in the room. He quickly reattached Lata's finger and disappeared without a trace.
"…Thank you."
"Enough with the pleasantries, let's hear your story. Why are you doing this?"
"What do you mean?"
"The Knight Lata I remember had a significant hostility towards me and was a very reckless person. That's why you challenged me to a duel and almost faced disgrace."
"Hmm, hmm! That is…"
"Tell me the reason for such a sudden change in your attitude. If there is no convincing explanation, I won't accept any compensation for my victory."
Lata's eyes widened, and then, as if making a decision, nodded and opened her mouth.
"I fell in love with a man named Jin Runecandle."
Jin almost spat out the tea that Gilly had brought.
"You fell in love with me? That's not a convincing reason. You do all this for such a trivial reason?"
Jin narrowed his eyes and continued, his face showing anger for the first time.
"My family's elders must have ordered the Ghost Corps to assassinate me. So, you should be trying to make up for your failure and carry out the order again, not trying to get close to me."
If Lata was really doing all this just because she "fell in love" with him, Jin didn't want her as an ally.

"It doesn't make sense. If I were a person of a prestigious martial arts family like you, it would. But Jin, I am just a mercenary who eats with a sword. It doesn't matter if I act like a lowly, despicable beast. Especially in a situation like this."
"What situation? Go on."
"After the duel with you, I experienced the terror at Sword Emperor Castle. I stayed there for about two weeks, watching how the incident unfolded. As a result, I came to one conclusion."
"What conclusion is that?"
"That if the Ghost Corps want to survive, they can no longer remain neutral."
An alliance? The Ghost Corps doesn't team up with any power. We only have clients and their requests. Jin Runecandle, I challenge you to a duel.
Lata's words, of course, went against the values ​​that the Ghost Corps, a mercenary group, had upheld until now.

"That day was special. It was the moment I realized my arrogance through the duel with you, and I was convinced that the war and power structure would flow in a completely different form from what I knew due to the terror."
The tunnels, demonic beasts, living golems, giant warships, transformed magicians, and the overwhelming power of the demons that revived them all.
As Lata said, the terror that Kinzello committed that day shattered the common sense most people had.

"But the royal family didn't protect Hailan after that. Even though a crazy group like that attacked Sword Emperor Castle. It's as if Sword Emperor Castle, where Ron was, was of little use to the royal family."
"Maybe the emperor just thought it was a good opportunity to keep Hailan in check."

"The power that Ron has is too great to think that way. The royal family must have had their own preparations and decided to abandon Hailan. If the royal family is that prepared, I wonder how Zifel and Runecandle would be. Kinzello showed his direct power."
Lata had a premonition of a 'new era' opening after that day.
It was said that it was difficult to continue living as a pure warrior or a mercenary group in this era. Even Ron Hailan was treated as unnecessary, not to mention the Ghost Corps.
That's why she had to choose who would dominate the new era and form a strong alliance with them.
"In that sense, I am convinced that you, Jin, will become the leader of Runecandle in the future. That's why I came to be on your side. Is this explanation convincing enough?"
